# install adds the Rex action and keeps the rest of init.lua. A second
# install does not add a second require line.
mkdir .config/rex
cp mine.lua .config/rex/init.lua
exec rexdiff install --key=ctrl+cmd+d --placement=zoomed
stdout 'wrote '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff.lua'
stdout 'config reloaded'
stdout 'press ctrl\+cmd\+d'
exec rexdiff install --key=ctrl+cmd+d --placement=zoomed
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua
grep 'local PLACEMENT = "zoomed"' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
grep 'rex.bind\("ctrl\+cmd\+d", "rexdiff_toggle"\)' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
cmp rex.log reloads.log

# Rex accepts the action.
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check .config/rex/init.lua
[realrex] stdout 'actions: 1'

# If uninstall cannot change init.lua, it keeps rexdiff.lua, so that
# init.lua does not require a missing file.
chmod 0444 .config/rex/init.lua
! exec rexdiff uninstall
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
chmod 0644 .config/rex/init.lua

# uninstall removes the action and keeps the rest.
exec rexdiff uninstall
stdout 'removed the rexdiff action from Rex'
cmp .config/rex/init.lua mine.lua
! exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# If Rex does not reload, install still writes the files and says what to do.
env REX_FAIL=1
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'reload Rex''s config yourself: rex config reload'
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# REX_CONFIG moves the configuration of Rex.
env REX_CONFIG=$WORK/other/init.lua
exec rexdiff install
exists other/rexdiff.lua
grep 'require\("rexdiff"\)' other/init.lua

# On macOS, the action runs a symlinked rexdiff through the link, so that
# it still works after brew upgrade.
[darwin] exec sh -c 'mkdir brew && ln -s "$(command -v rexdiff)" brew/rexdiff'
[darwin] exec $WORK/brew/rexdiff install
[darwin] grep 'local BIN = "'$WORK'/brew/rexdiff"' other/rexdiff.lua

# uninstall without an install changes nothing and does not fail.
env REX_CONFIG=$WORK/none/init.lua
exec rexdiff uninstall
stdout 'removed the rexdiff action from Rex'
! exists none

-- mine.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
-- installed.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
require("rexdiff") -- rexdiff toggle; see rexdiff.lua
-- reloads.log --
config reload
config reload
